posts.text:
I introduced one of the first bills in the Senate to help veterans exposed to toxic burn pits. That fight became part of the bipartisan PACT Act, and this week marks 4 years since this landmark legislation was signed into law — expanding VA health care to nearly 3.5 million veterans exposed to toxic substances. 

When we ask our young men and women to fight for our nation, we make a promise to care for them when they come home. The PACT Act is a promise kept.
